## gaps

- No X handle yet (@allthings or @allthingsdev): the drafts say @[x-handle]. Set launchXHandle in core/src/promo/launch.ts, or pass --x-handle.
- No next evening yet: the drafts hold a placeholder until the trivia night is published. Pass --next <slug> then.

## before posting

- [ ] allthings.dev serves the new site and every allthingsweb.dev address redirects to it, as every draft says (infra/docs/r2-migration.md, the full cutover). Post nothing before.
- [ ] Post the X thread from @[x-handle], each post a reply to the one before.
- [ ] Display names say all things before the posts do: X, Bluesky, the LinkedIn page, the Discord server and the Luma calendar.
- [ ] Send each Meetup announcement from its own group, to all its members.

## x: thread 1/6 (259 / 280)

All Things Web is now all things.

The same evenings for people who build software, in the neighborhoods of San Francisco, under one name: all things/_. Each evening fills the slot after the slash.

The site is allthings.dev. allthingsweb.dev redirects there.

## x: thread 2/6 (236 / 280)

Every evening has a short link, its name as an address: all things/effect lives at allthings.dev/effect.

A link, once given, is that evening's for good, so nothing printed, posted or put in a QR code ever comes to mean another evening.

## x: thread 3/6 (159 / 280)

Everyone who has been on stage has a page now, at allthings.dev/people: their talks and parts at our evenings, latest first, and the talks they gave elsewhere.

## x: thread 4/6 (147 / 280)

Some evenings aren't ours. When someone else runs one we think is good, we share it: it's listed beside ours, marked shared, with who organizes it.

## x: thread 5/6 (213 / 280)

Hackathons start from at/hack, a template: fork it, build, hand in a public repo. Projects are judged on whether they work before how they look: judges run each one and its tests.

github.com/allthingsweb-dev/hack

All Things Web is now all things, at allthings.dev. allthingsweb.dev redirects there.

## linkedin (1081 / 3000)

All Things Web is now all things.

The evenings stay what they were: for people who build software, in the neighborhoods of San Francisco, about who's on stage and what they built. What changes is the name, all things/_, where each evening fills the slot after the slash: all things/effect, all things/expo.

The site is now allthings.dev, and allthingsweb.dev redirects there. With it:

- Every evening has a short link, allthings.dev/<topic>. A link, once given, is that evening's for good.
- Everyone who has been on stage has a page, at allthings.dev/people: their talks and parts at our evenings, and the talks they gave elsewhere.
- Evenings other people run that we think are good are listed beside ours, marked shared, with who organizes them.
- Hackathons start from at/hack, a template: fork it, build, hand in a public repo. Projects are judged on whether they work before how they look. github.com/allthingsweb-dev/hack

Next: [next evening], [day, time], [hosted at …]. https://allthings.dev/[next]

Talk between evenings → discord.gg/B3Sm4b5mfD
On X: x.com/[x-handle]

## discord (769 / 2000)

**All Things Web is now all things.**

Same evenings, same server. The name is all things/\_, and each evening fills the slot after the slash: all things/effect, all things/expo.

**What changed**
- The site is **allthings.dev**; allthingsweb.dev redirects there.
- Every evening has a short link, allthings.dev/\<topic\>. Once given, it's that evening's for good.
- Everyone who has been on stage has a page: allthings.dev/people.
- Evenings other people run that we think are good are listed beside ours, marked shared.
- Hackathons start from **at/hack**, a template: fork it, build, hand in a public repo. <https://github.com/allthingsweb-dev/hack>

## luma: newsletter (1082 / 5000)

subject: All Things Web is now all things

All Things Web is now all things: the same evenings for people who build software, in the neighborhoods of San Francisco, under one name, all things/\_. Each evening fills the slot after the slash: all things/effect, all things/expo.

Nothing changes here: you keep following this calendar, and every evening's seats are still taken here.

**What changed**

- The site is **[allthings.dev](https://allthings.dev)**, and allthingsweb.dev redirects there.
- Every evening has a short link, allthings.dev/\<topic\>. Once given, it's that evening's for good.
- Everyone who has been on stage has a page: allthings.dev/people.
- Evenings other people run that we think are good are listed beside ours, marked shared.
- Hackathons start from **at/hack**, a template: fork it, build, hand in a public repo. <https://github.com/allthingsweb-dev/hack>

## meetup: React San Francisco Bay Area (771 / 5000)

group: https://www.meetup.com/reactjs-san-francisco/

subject: React San Francisco Bay Area's evenings are now all things

The evenings React San Francisco Bay Area lists went by All Things Web. They're now all things: one name, all things/_, and each evening fills the slot after the slash.

Nothing changes for you here. This group continues under all things, you stay a member, and each evening is still listed here. Seats are on Luma (luma.com/allthingsweb); the list on Meetup is a waitlist.

What's new on allthings.dev (allthingsweb.dev redirects there): a short link for every evening, allthings.dev/<topic>; a page for everyone who has been on stage; evenings others run that we think are good, marked shared; and at/hack, the template hackathons start from.

Next: [next evening], [day, time], [hosted at …]. https://allthings.dev/[next]

Talk between evenings → discord.gg/B3Sm4b5mfD

## about: history (331 characters)

With the name, the site moved from allthingsweb.dev to allthings.dev, and the old addresses redirect. Each evening has its short link, allthings.dev/<topic>, and keeps it. Everyone who has been on stage has a page. Evenings others run that we think are good are listed beside ours, marked shared. And hackathons start from at/hack.
